title: Auth Me Tenants Response DTO
description: 200 body for GET /api/v1/auth/me/tenants — the tenants the authenticated caller can switch between (portal tenant switcher, TraigentFrontend#2250). data.items holds ONLY the caller's own active memberships in non-deleted tenants, default first; it is never a tenant directory, platform admins included. data.switchable is true only for an interactive JWT/cookie session with no tenant claim on a deployment with no pinned tenant — exactly when the Backend honours an X-Tenant-Id header naming one of those tenants. When switchable is false, items holds at most the membership for the request's resolved tenant.

items.description: The caller's own active memberships, ordered is_default DESC then membership created_at ASC.

switchable.description: Whether the caller may select another listed tenant via the X-Tenant-Id header. False for API keys, service tokens, tenant-claimed (e.g. SSO) tokens and deployment-pinned installs.

role.description: The caller's membership role in this tenant, as stored on the membership.
